title: CultureBank: An Online Community-Driven Knowledge Base Towards Culturally Aware Language Technologies

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through grounded evaluation using contextualized consulting scenarios to test if LLM responses entail specific cultural knowledge, direct evaluation via binary classification of cultural norms, and zero-shot evaluation on downstream cross-cultural benchmarks (GlobalOpinionQA and CultureNLI).

Measured using the GlobalOpinionQA benchmark to calculate the Jensen-Shannon Distance between model-predicted distributions and actual survey responses from people in different countries, assessing how balanced the model's representation is across nations.
